title: Shelter 825 Neuron Garden
description: A surreal underground scene shows a blue devil with horns holding a glowing orb containing a neural network of roots and lightning. A blonde woman in a blue corset dress stands chained to the orb while a small green creature holds a red brain-like object at her feet. The cracked concrete shelter is overgrown with colorful flowers and roots.
prompt: A muscular blue devil with horns and glowing red eyes stands inside a cracked concrete bunker, holding a large transparent orb filled with a glowing neural network of white roots and blue lightning. A blonde woman in a blue corset dress and gold chain stands beside him. A small green creature with a flower on its head holds a red brain at the bottom. The floor is covered in colorful flowers, roots and moss. Text on the wall reads SHELTER 825 NEURON GARDEN BIND THE ROOT. Dark surreal fantasy style.
